title: process App
text: Normalization page QFeatures objects can normalised step. Several normalisation methods available (). sum max, feature’s intensity divided maximum sum feature, respectively. two methods applied along features (rows). center.mean center.median centre respective sample (column) intensities subtracting respective column means medians. div.mean div.median divide column means medians. diff.median centres samples (columns) match grand median subtracting respective column median differences grand median. Using quantiles quantiles.robust applies (robust) quantile normalisation, implemented preprocessCore::normalize.quantiles() preprocessCore::normalize.quantiles.robust(). vsn uses vsn::vsn2() function. Note latter also glog-transforms intensities. See respective manuals details function arguments. normalisation method selected, click Apply normalisation (B); density graph normalisation displayed. Click Save processed sets (C).

title: process App
text: Log transformation page analysing continuous data using parametric methods (t-test linear models), often necessary log-transform data. log base set log2 default, can also set log10 ln (). pseudocount value can added (B) handle zero values data applying logarithm. click Apply log transform (C); display density plot log transformation. done, forget click Save processed sets (D).

title: process App
text: Imputation page two types mechanisms resulting missing values LC/MSMS experiments. Missing values resulting absence detection feature, despite ions present detectable concentrations. example, can happen case ion suppression result stochastic, data-dependent nature MS acquisition method. missing values expected randomly distributed data defined missing random (MAR) missing completely random (MCAR). Biologically relevant missing values, resulting absence low abundance ions (limit detection instrument). missing values expected randomly distributed data defined missing random (MNAR). See Imputing quantitative proteomics data information. First choose imputation method (): knn: nearest neighbour averaging, implemented impute::impute.knn function. Note function used default parameters. MinDet: performs imputation left-censored missing data using deterministic minimal value approach. Considering expression data n samples p features, sample, missing entries replaced minimal value observed sample. minimal value observed estimated q-th quantile (default q = 0.01) observed values sample. Implemented imputeLCMD::impute.MinDet. Note function used default parameters. zero: replaces missing values 0. click Apply imputation (B). imputation run, page display post-imputation density plot can colour colData (C). imputation step finished, forget Save processed sets (D).

title: process App
text: Aggregation page stage, possible use peptide-level intensities aggregate peptide-level data protein intensities. , quantitative feature aggregation function required. function, called Function aggregate (), takes matrix input returns vector length equal ncol(x). function can one following types: MsCoreUtils::medianPolish() fits additive model (two-way decomposition) using Tukey’s median polish procedure stats::medpolish(). MsCoreUtils::robustSummary calculates robust aggregation using MASS::rlm() (default). base::colMeans() use mean column. matrixStats::colMedians() use median column. base::colSums() use sum column. See MsCoreUtils::aggregate_by_vector() aggregation functions. rowData variable (B) also needed define aggregate features assays. two variables set, click Aggregate (C). aggregation boxplot displayed. boxplot shows feature coloured colData value. aggregation done, click Save processed sets.
